items.coder_A: not_glioblastoma (uncertain: cohort B IDH-wildtype glioma of unspecified grade would largely be GBM)
items.reason: Conditions say only 'Glioma'. Cohort A is 'grade II or III IDH-mutated glioma' and cohort B is 'Histologically confirmed IDH-wildtype glioma that has recurred following therapy', with no grade stated. Glioblastoma, grade 4 or IDH-wildtype grade 4 glioma is never named in a qualifying field, and R7 requires grade 4 to be explicitly allowed.

items.coder_B: not_glioblastoma (uncertain: cohort B may include glioblastoma but the record does not say so)
items.reason: Same decision. 'IDH-wildtype glioma' with no grade is not the C7 term 'IDH-wildtype grade 4 astrocytic glioma'.

note: This is a potential clinically important miss. Under CNS5, a recurrent IDH-wildtype diffuse astrocytic glioma after radiotherapy (cohort B) is almost always glioblastoma, but C7 requires naming, so the trial is excluded at S5. XL may want it in a 'GBM implied, not named' listing. If it were included, it would count as candidate-matched (HRR mutations matched to olaparib, cohort B enrichment). Temozolomide 50 mg/m2 days 1-7 is established_therapy_experiment (both coders). Priority-3 biomarker role disagreements (IDH and CDKN2A_B as eligibility vs enrichment): each applies to one cohort/arm, so enrichment.
